public_source_basis.claim_used: DVOL supplies a forward-looking volatility regime and no directional input.
public_source_basis.claim_used_2: Perpetual premium links the contract to spot while open interest measures outstanding leveraged inventory.

mechanism.claim: In an elevated implied-volatility regime, leveraged inventory that begins rebuilding immediately after a completed eight-hour contraction can represent fragile chase inventory. When at least one quarter of the prior log-OI loss is refilled while the premium index makes a large same-block displacement, fade that completed premium displacement for one inventory cycle.
mechanism.side: negative strict sign of the current completed eight-hour premium-index close-minus-open displacement
mechanism.why_distinct: HVPOIUR requires current-block OI contraction and fades contemporaneous basis pressure. HVOIRR requires a two-block contraction-to-expansion transition and quantifies causal refill of prior lost inventory. HVOER uses BTC-return expert transitions. No prior event set, control, or clock is reused.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: DVOL and absolute premium displacement must each occupy their causal upper 40%.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: The two-block OI refill transition, derivatives-only direction, and fixed eight-hour boundaries are absent from Gross9 definitions.

features.prior_oi_block: 96 exact unique BTCUSDT 5m OI rows in [D-16h,D-8h); prior_log_change<0
features.current_oi_block: 96 exact unique BTCUSDT 5m OI rows in [D-8h,D); current_log_change>0
features.premium_block: 480 exact unique BTCUSDT premium-index 1m rows in [D-8h,D); displacement=last close-first open, finite and strict nonzero
features.dvol_regime: exact completed DVOL hour ending D with positive close
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks over at most 270 source-valid boundaries, minimum 180; current excluded
features.eligibility: abs(current premium displacement) rank>=0.60, DVOL close rank>=0.60, contraction-to-refill transition, and refill fraction>=0.25
features.availability: D after every constituent source row is complete

clock.reservation: fixed nonoverlapping boundaries; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: not a signal input; q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage economics pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure: source, novelty, train, test, eval, final; no threshold, side, hold, clock, subset, source, or control repair.
